items.title: Mixture-of-Expert Blocks Contain Strong Hallucination Detection Signals
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.17687v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Despite their widespread use, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain limited by a fundamental problem: the generation of plausible but false content, known as hallucinations. Most existing detection methods operate at the answer or sentence level, yet per-token detection is essential for localizing hallucinated spans and enabling fine-grained interventions. In this paper, we explore the use of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm to address this gap. In MoE architectures, a single forward pass activates a sparse subset of experts (i.e., distinct feedforward networks per layer) via a routing mechanism, producing internal signals (e.g., router entropy, expert disagreement, and expert usage patterns) that are unavailable in dense architectures and have not been previously exploited for hallucination detection. To this end, we introduce InnerExpert, the first method to leverage these MoE-specific signals for per-token hallucination detection.
items.reason_zh: 发现MoE块中包含强幻觉检测信号，为幻觉定位提供新方法，具有高实用价值。
items.summary_zh: 该论文针对大语言模型（LLM）的幻觉问题，提出利用混合专家（MoE）块中的信号进行幻觉检测。现有检测方法多在答案或句子级别操作，而逐token检测对于定位幻觉片段和实现细粒度干预至关重要。研究发现，MoE块中的某些信号与幻觉的产生密切相关，可以作为强检测信号。通过分析这些信号，论文提出了一种新的检测方法，能够在token级别识别幻觉，从而更精确地定位问题区域。实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准上优于现有方法，为幻觉检测提供了新的思路。
items.title_zh: 混合专家块包含强幻觉检测信号

items.title: Same GRPO recipe on three from-scratch LLMs (353M/316M/672M) gave three different outcomes, with no clean relationship to scale [P]
items.raw_text:
I trained three LLMs from scratch in raw PyTorch then post-trained each one with SFT and then GRPO. Same process every time: same synthetic arithmetic curriculum, same reward function, same hyperparameters, same KL coefficient.

Pre-training went as expected, the val loss went down as the model got more modern techniques (V1 to V2) and bigger (V3 being the biggest). However, GRPO hurt both V2 and V3 and I'm not sure why.

Setup

V1 V2 V3
Params 353M 316M 672M
d_model / layers 1024 / 24 1024 / 24 1536 / 24
Attention MHA Differential +
items.reason_zh: 从零训练三个不同规模LLM，GRPO结果与规模无清晰关系，反直觉发现值得深入探讨。
items.summary_zh: 作者在原始PyTorch中从零训练了三个LLM（353M/316M/672M），并用相同的SFT和GRPO流程进行后训练，包括相同的合成算术课程、奖励函数、超参数和KL系数。预训练结果符合预期，验证损失随技术现代化和规模增大而下降。但GRPO后训练结果却出现三种不同结果，与模型规模无清晰关系。这一发现挑战了规模决定强化学习效果的假设，对理解LLM后训练机制有重要启示。
items.title_zh: 相同GRPO配方在三个从零训练的LLM上产生不同结果，与规模无清晰关系

items.title: Beyond the Trace: Coupling an Interpretable Reasoning-State Readout to Native MoE Routing
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.17638v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: What a reasoning model writes is only a partial record of the process that produces it. We introduce a two-level internal readout for mixture-of-experts reasoning. We first distill vocabulary-scale J-space into J64, a 64-axis semantic frame learned from the model's own reasoning states. J64 reveals readable process state that the emitted trace does not show: it separates inference effort from problem-induced strain. It also adds 0.096 to 0.135 held-out AUC over a baseline that reads the same rollout as token occupancy and aggregates it in exactly the same way. We then reconstruct J64 from native expert-routing statistics. The result is R64, a low-overhead proxy: its median per-axis correlation with J64 is 0.69 to 0.86 across three models and two families, and on gpt-oss-20b it preserves 95 to 100% of J64's predictive gain. items.summary_zh: 本文针对推理模型的可解释性问题，提出了一种两级的内部读出机制，用于混合专家（MoE）推理模型。作者首先将词汇规模的J空间蒸馏为J64，一个从模型自身推理状态学习到的64轴语义框架。J64揭示了发射轨迹未包含的可读过程状态。然后，他们将该读出与原生MoE路由耦合，使得推理过程更加透明。实验表明，该方法能够提供更丰富的推理过程信息。

items.title: munder-difflin 的多 agent 协调实现
items.raw_text:
刷到这个仓库的时候是被名字骗进去的，munder-difflin，《办公室》里那家最差的纸业公司，主管 Michael 也搬了过来当了这层楼的老板。演示视频里一堆像素小人在办公室里走来走去，互相发消息的时候还有信封在桌子之间飞，看着像个玩具。
后来翻到一份叫 docs/message-queue.md 的文档，一千多字只讲一件很窄的事：一个真实的 CLI 只有一根输入行，而想用它的不止你一个。这篇就记一下里面几处认真想过的地方。

项目概况

munder-difflin 是个 Electron 桌面应用，把你已经在终端里跑的 agent CLI 包起来当 agent 用，README 里列了十种：claude、agy、codex、grok、kimi、qwen、opencode、crush、pi、copilot。每个会话是一个真进程，同时是办公室地板上的一个小人，走去哪个工位取决于它在用哪个工具。
到今天的 HEAD（92461ab），从 5 月 31 日起 710 次提交，src/ 下 185 个 ts/tsx 文件、53,166 行，index.ts 4,582 行，hive.ts 2,464 行，38 个测试文件跑在 node --test 上。版本 0.4.4，README 自己写的状态是 working prototype，这个自我定位是准的，功能铺得很宽，有些地方深得意外，有些地方文档已经和代码不一样了。
items.reason_zh: 深入剖析多agent协调的工程细节，从消息队列设计到CLI复用，有实践洞察。
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了开源项目munder-difflin，一个多agent协调实现。作者被项目名称吸引，发现其演示视频中像素小人在办公室互动，看似玩具，但深入阅读docs/message-queue.md文档后，发现其中认真思考了真实CLI只有一根输入行但多个agent需要同时使用的问题。文章记录了项目中的几处设计考量，涉及消息队列、agent间通信等，展示了多agent系统实现中的工程细节和取舍。

items.title: Quoting Jeremy Morrell
items.raw_text:
My hypothesis is that there is a new opportunity for Extensible Software on the web. LLMs radically lower the cost of authoring extensions, and modern sandbox primitives lower the deployment cost and provide good security boundaries. We can build our app as a solid, accountable core, and allow users to safely extend it in many directions by having LLMs fill in the missing pieces. We can give our users super powers.

— Jeremy Morrell, Extensible Software in the age of LLMs

Tags: sandboxing, llms, ai, generative-ai
items.reason_zh: 提出LLM时代可扩展软件的新机遇，结合沙箱原语，对开发者有启发。
items.summary_zh: Jeremy Morrell提出假设：在LLM时代，Web上可扩展软件迎来新机遇。LLM大幅降低了扩展的编写成本，现代沙箱原语降低了部署成本并提供良好的安全边界。我们可以将应用构建为稳固、负责任的核心，并允许用户通过扩展进行定制。这一观点为软件架构设计提供了新思路。
